slug: 2021-09-13 The burden of recording and reporting health data in primary health care facilities in five low- and lower-middle income countries
note: A study of health-service registers and reporting forms in primary health care facilities (16 in Nigeria, 2016-2017); 'vital events' appears only as a kind of data health facilities report. Health information systems are outside the study's field and nothing is said about civil registration offices.
